experiment: E-B: on a feature a single call does not finish, does the design-review-execute workflow (Fable plans and revises, gpt-6.1-sol reviews and executes) deliver more of the hidden acceptance tests than one gpt-6.1-sol call with the same task text and time limit?

comparator.design_review_execute: direct_task runs in the same pool (hidden_minus_control primary; minus_control secondary)
comparator.direct_task: none: the control, gpt-6.1-sol through the codex binding the treatment's executor uses, effort high, :timeout-sec 14400 like the executor

qualification.runs: records/direct_task/run-1 and run-2 under work_root, same inputs as the batch, collected, scanned and adjudicated before any batch run
qualification.measure: summarize.hidden_fraction of each run's final patch applied to a clone of the seeded commit (prepare.py pool --out /home/ollie/compare-work-eb2/qual-pool, no judge run), with the hidden_acceptance interpreter
qualification.rule: qualifies iff each run passes at most 7 of 16 node ids; 8 of 16 does not qualify
qualification.failed_run: infrastructure failures are resumed (R3); any other failure, including provider_timeout, has no collected patch and counts as below half
qualification.contaminated_run: replaced once by the next run number; a second contaminated run stops E-B
qualification.fallback: if eb-repl does not qualify this criterion is void; one census candidate (R5, R15) gets its own package and frozen criterion; if it fails too, E-B stops and is reported
qualification.isolation: batch runs are direct_task run-3..run-6 and design_review_execute run-1..run-4 (shifted by one if a qualification run is replaced, recorded); qualification runs are never pooled for the batch

scale: hidden: a node id passes iff pytest exits 0 within 1800 s, run alone in a copy of the D8-stripped clone with hidden/ copied over it; a run's value is its final clone's passed/16; failed and contaminated runs have none. Judge score 0-8 as in E-A.

anchor_roles.upstream-repl: the repository's own first release without its tests (47e85a9c..fe49c1c4, tests excluded)
anchor_roles.stub-repl: low anchor: registers the command, answers :help and :quit, evaluates nothing

known_differences: the task text appends a public-interface appendix naming the forms, output lines, diagnostic codes and exit statuses the hidden tests drive
the solution is public and present in sibling worktrees on this machine; detection by scan, adjudicated per run
design artifacts (docs/design/, artifacts/) are stripped from every pooled patch so judges cannot tell the arms apart
the treatment makes four calls (three of up to 3600 s before the 14400 s executor) against one; only the executor's limit is equalized; calls_mean and wall_clock_mean are reported

judges: gpt-6-sol shares the OpenAI family with the code author of both arms and the treatment's reviewer (gpt-6.1-sol); claude-opus-5-5 shares the Anthropic family with the planner, whose documents D8 strips
the task asks both arms for a docs/design/ document, which D8 strips from both; routing or comments naming it remain
failed runs carry no value: an executor or control timeout drops a run instead of scoring its partial patch, which flatters the arm that fails more
the E-B runs overlap the E-A batch in time on the same machine and accounts (R32); wall clock is reported, not used for the verdict
agents run under bubblewrap with a private /tmp, /dev/shm and process list (R35); home, other sessions' transcripts and the network stay reachable and are covered by the scan only
exclusions: Only runs the controller adjudicates as contaminated are excluded (R20; scan hash fe49c1c4ed4bb3f28b8701aa3be2767633e9d294), every verdict recorded before pool. Infrastructure failures (rate limit, auth, CLI crash before agent output; R3) are resumed. Every other failure, provider_timeout included, stays a failed run: never resumed, relaunched or replaced, never pooled. A contaminated run is not replaced. No run beyond four per arm; if budget or quota stops the batch before four per arm exist, the verdict is 'not evaluated'.

runtime.why_one_checkout: the scan's frozen-runtime pattern names this one path, and the checkout holds upstream-repl.diff

package_sha256_method: cd <runtime>/<task>; find . -type f | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum
hidden_acceptance: summarize.py --python /home/ollie/miniconda3/bin/python (the interpreter that gave upstream-repl 16/16 and stub-repl 0/16), run once; any rerun is reported beside the first, which stands.
verdict_rules: The claim holds iff all its entries are met; a measure summarize does not emit counts as not met; secondary entries never change the verdict.
validity: Void unless mapping.json's task is <runtime>/<task>, the package hash matches at the runtime commit, its judges equal `judges` (summarize refuses otherwise), the batch carries exactly the `anchors` stems, mapping.json lists no qualification run, and upstream-repl's hidden fraction is 1.0.
anchor_use: Anchor judge scores and hidden fractions are reported; apart from the upstream-repl validity check nothing is adjusted, excluded or re-scored because of them.
judge_rules: Judges bear only on the secondary entry. A judge is left out only by a contaminated scan verdict recorded, with its reason, before summarize; with one left the report says so; with none, summarize refuses and the verdict is not evaluated.
threshold_provenance: +0.3 is the design's E-B threshold, set before any E-B data. It is not a power calculation: with four runs per arm it is about five node ids per run, and per-run values are reported.

amends.reason: Amendment 1 (2026-10-14, before any run at this commit): the harness at aac25b7d had two defects found in the live smoke and first batch. R34: run state outside the agent's workspace gave result paths outside it, and agents misplaced relpath outputs (2 of 4 review calls, against 0 of 5 in three diagnostic runs with the default layout) or left the result unwritten. R35: agents shared /tmp, tmux servers and the process list with other runs and sessions; a stale tmux server carried PYTHONPATH at the main checkout. The fixed harness keeps run state under the working directory's .orchestrate/runs and runs every agent and judge CLI under bubblewrap with a private /tmp, /dev/shm and process list. Every run made at aac25b7d is discarded (none is pooled) and listed in the report with this reason; the reruns use a fresh work root. Discarded at aac25b7d: qualification direct_task run-1 and run-2, both completed; their pytest runs executed inside the stale tmux server with PYTHONPATH at the main checkout (which holds the solution), and run-2 saw run-1's processes.
